value.definition: what an agent must read for the akasha domain it works within

invariants.statement: An agent warrants the akasha domain.
Only an agent warrants the akasha domain.
An akasha domain whose page cannot be found is no warrant.

value.definition: what an agent must read for the type every role is held to

invariants.statement: An agent warrants the role page type.
The invariants and directives every role is held to are on the type rather than on any one role.
An agent stating no role of its own warrants the type all the same.
Only an agent warrants the role page type.
A role page type that cannot be found is no warrant.

value.definition: what a seat must read for the assignment it states

invariants.statement: A seat warrants the assignment the seat states.
A seat stating no assignment warrants no assignment.
An assignment whose page cannot be found is no warrant.
Only a seat warrants an assignment of the page that seat states.
A seat stating an initiative warrants the domain that initiative names.
An assignment is looked up under the page type the assignment is stated under.

value.definition: what a seat must read for the taboo terms its change writes

invariants.statement: A taboo term whose pattern finds the text a change adds is warranted.
A taboo term whose pattern finds that text split at its camelCase seams is warranted too.
A seam opens between a lower letter and an upper letter.
A seam opens between a digit and an upper letter.
A seam opens where a run of upper letters gives way to a word.
An underscore or a hyphen is left as that character is.
The split copy is a matching aid rather than text the change wrote.
The text owed for a term found only in the split copy says the term is inside a camelCase name.
The split text itself is never quoted back.
Text a change leaves unchanged is not text the change adds.
A term warrants nothing of the page stating the term.
A term warrants nothing of a page whose type runs no taboo check.
Which page type a path names is read off that path's own name.
A page type's own file is warranted whatever that page type says of its pages.
A file beside a page is warranted as that page is.
A file whose property has bytes rather than text is read by no term here.
Whether a property has bytes is read off that property's own page.
The text owed names every sense the term bars and the wording written instead.
The text owed names every sense the term keeps as well.
The text owed says of each list whether the list has kept senses or barred senses.
The text owed for a term naming no kept sense names only the senses the term bars.
A pattern that does not compile finds nothing rather than refusing the change.
Nothing here judges which sense was meant.
A change handed no bodies warrants nothing.

value.definition: what a seat must read for the domains above the one it states

invariants.statement: A seat warrants every domain above the domain that seat answers for.
A domain above another domain is the one naming that other domain among its parts.
The chain is walked to the top rather than one step.
The domain answered for is no ancestor of itself.
A seat stating an initiative walks from the domain that initiative names.
A seat stating a domain with nothing above that domain warrants no domain.
The page a seat answers for is found under the page type its assignment states.

value.definition: what a seat must read for where the file's page sits

invariants.statement: A file warrants the page that names the file among its parts.
The page a file belongs to is composed out of that file's own name.
One reading of the index answers every question a run of this warrant asks.

value.definition: what a seat must read for the file it changes

invariants.statement: A file warrants itself.
A file that does not yet exist warrants nothing of itself.
A generated file warrants nothing of itself.
A file whose body is not text warrants nothing of itself.
A body holding a zero byte is no text.
A file of that name in another folder warrants itself.
An index that cannot answer leaves every file warranting itself.
Whatever else warrants the file remains unchanged.
The body warranted is the body on disk and the body a read records.

value.definition: what a seat must read for the type of the page it changes

invariants.statement: A page answers to its type alone.
A page answers to no type that its type extends.
The type a page answers to is read before the page is changed.
Only a page answers to a type.
A file sitting beside a page by a file property is no page and warrants no type of its own.
A type whose page cannot be found is no warrant.

value.definition: what a seat must read for a file that is one property's own

invariants.statement: A page property's file warrants its page and its property's type.
A property's file warrants its page whatever the file has.

value.definition: what a seat must read for the properties the page states

invariants.statement: A page warrants the page property type of every property the page states.
A page warrants nothing for a property the page does not state.
`Never Depend On Everything` refuses this warrant a loader edge, which would reach every page.

value.definition: what a seat must read for the initiatives above the one it states

invariants.statement: A seat warrants every initiative the one that seat states is under.
An initiative is above the initiative naming that initiative as its parent.
The initiative the seat states is no ancestor of itself.
A seat stating no initiative warrants no initiative.

value.definition: what a seat must read for the person it states

invariants.statement: A seat warrants the person the seat states.
A seat stating no person warrants no person.
A person whose page cannot be found is no warrant.
Only a seat warrants a person.
A person is named by its slug wherever the seat states the person under a page type.

value.definition: what a seat must read for the persona it states

invariants.statement: A seat warrants the persona the seat states.
A seat stating no persona warrants no persona.
A persona whose page cannot be found is no warrant.
Only a seat warrants a persona.
A persona is named by its slug wherever the seat states the persona under a page type.

value.definition: what a seat must read for the role it states

invariants.statement: A seat warrants the role the seat states.
A seat stating no role warrants no role.
A role whose page cannot be found is no warrant.
Only a seat warrants a role.

value.definition: what a seat must read for the type every persona is held to

invariants.statement: A seat warrants the persona page type.
A seat stating no persona warrants the type all the same.
A subagent speaks to nobody as a persona.
A subagent warrants no type here.
A persona page type that cannot be found is no warrant.
